_comment: Illustrations de l'app iOS, direction affiche (même réglages que manifest-poster.json), en deux couleurs : marine et safran sur papier crème. progress_poster = carte d'entrée « Ma progression » (profil), progress_hero = en-tête de la page « Ma progression », ambassador_poster = bannière « Deviens ambassadeur » des réglages. Sorties converties en JPEG dans ios/Sophia/Assets.xcassets/<nom>.imageset (carré 480 px pour progress_poster, 1200 × 900 pour les deux autres).

items.name: progress_poster
items.prompt: A small simple navy figure climbing a staircase made of five big stacked books, a large saffron star with a laurel wreath shining above the top step. Two-color linocut print, paper-cut shapes: only deep navy blue ink and saffron yellow ink on plain cream off-white paper, the cream paper background fills most of the image, bold simple flat forms, subtle paper grain, generous empty cream space, no red, no light blue, no teal, no text, no letters, no outlines.

items.name: progress_hero
items.prompt: On a plain cream off-white paper background: a small simple navy figure climbing a staircase made of big stacked navy and saffron books that rises from the lower left to the right, a large saffron star framed by two saffron laurel branches above the top step, a few tiny saffron sparkles in the empty cream sky. Two-color linocut print, paper-cut shapes: only deep navy blue ink and saffron yellow ink on plain cream off-white paper, the cream paper background fills most of the image, bold simple flat forms, subtle paper grain, generous empty cream space, no red, no light blue, no teal, no green, no text, no letters, no outlines.

items.name: ambassador_poster
items.prompt: A cheerful simple navy figure holding up a big saffron megaphone, from which saffron stars, navy hearts and small open books fly out to the right; a little pennant flag planted beside the figure. Two-color linocut print, paper-cut shapes: only deep navy blue ink and saffron yellow ink on plain cream off-white paper, the cream paper background fills most of the image, bold simple flat forms, subtle paper grain, generous empty cream space, no red, no light blue, no teal, no text, no letters, no outlines.
